I will read the allegation before we move.","sfx_cue":"paper straightened"},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Do it quietly.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"khot","text":"The charge is cheating by falsely representing judicial authority, and dishonestly inducing the delivery of money, property and possession through documents presented as lawful awards.","sfx_cue":""}]},{"ep":12,"title":"The One Judgment","lines":[{"speaker":"khot","text":"Name every award, call it worthless, and the prosecution will record your cooperation.","sfx_cue":"interview room recorder clicking on"},{"speaker":"morris","text":"You want me to condemn all of them before trial.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"khot","text":"I want a complete list and a truthful description of your authority.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"There was no court appointment. That part is already established by the record.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Then why do you need me?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"khot","text":"Because thirty-four papers changed thirty-four lives, and your handwriting joins them.","sfx_cue":"files placed one by one"},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Some disputes were genuine.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"hardik","text":"A genuine dispute does not create a genuine tribunal.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Parties came voluntarily.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"khot","text":"Some did. Your choice remains respectable either way.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"What exactly are you offering?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"khot","text":"Full disclosure. Identification of every affected person. Admission that the awards have no judicial force.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"And then?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"khot","text":"Your cooperation goes into the remand report and the prosecution brief.","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"morris","text":"Lighter charges?","sfx_cue":""},{"speaker":"khot","text":"A narrower allegation, if the evidence permits.
